tagline: Unified digital learning and server-validated virtual internship ecosystem combining modular video LMS, gamified leveling incentives, and automated compliance.

thumbnail.alt: NextLevel Academy learning platform and virtual internship interface

blocks.heading: Operational context & problem statement
paragraphs: Prior to the development of this platform, NextLevel Academy conducted all training operations through in-person, offline sessions. This legacy model incurred high operational overhead, created geographical bottlenecks, and resulted in fragmented progress tracking across disconnected spreadsheets.

The web platform was engineered as an integrated, monorepo software ecosystem addressing three core requirements: (1) centralized, self-paced online course delivery via a proprietary video LMS, (2) heightened student retention through structured gamification and tier-based voucher rewards, and (3) a server-validated virtual internship environment providing automated presence enforcement and task assessment for partner vocational schools.

blocks.heading: Public discovery & verified credentials
paragraphs: The public-facing surface serves as the entry point for prospective students and external credential verifiers, designed for high conversion, minimal latency, and zero friction.

The architecture provides an interactive landing page showcasing available curricula, multi-tier sprint previews, instructor profiles, and lifetime pricing. Integrated Midtrans Snap checkout handles instant transactions (QRIS, Virtual Accounts, and E-Wallets) with dynamic voucher code discount validation.

To protect academic reputation, the platform features a public verification endpoint (/cert/:publicId) linked directly via QR codes on issued certificates, enabling immediate cryptographic verification of graduate authenticity without requiring user login.

blocks.heading: Self-paced LMS & gamified retention mechanics
paragraphs: Student dropout rates in self-paced digital education frequently stem from unstructured pacing and lack of tangible milestones. NextLevel Academy counters this through a cohesive combination of strict sequential gating, autosaving study tools, and an engaging progression loop.

Sequential Video Player & Autosave Notes: Video streams delivered via Bunny.net Stream CDN are bound to sequential completion requirements, ensuring prerequisites are mastered before advancing. The learning interface features a split-pane autosaving Markdown editor that persists personal notes to PostgreSQL on every keystroke.

Automated Mastery Quizzes: Each module concludes with an automated assessment requiring a minimum 80% passing grade. An anti-brute-force mechanism limits users to 3 consecutive attempts before enforcing a 30-minute study cooldown.

Linear Gamification & Voucher Economy: User activity awards experience points under the formula REQ(L) = 744 + 124 × (L - 1), awarding +15 EXP for videos, +90 EXP for quizzes, and +600 EXP upon course completion. Reaching milestones unlocks commercial discount vouchers: 20% at Level 5, 35% at Level 10, and 50% at Level 15.

Immutable Snapshot Certification: Upon course completion, the system issues a verified digital certificate. The recipient's full name is permanently frozen (Certificate.recipientName) at the moment of issuance, ensuring certificate integrity even if the student later edits their account profile.

blocks.heading: Virtual internship & scoped cohort mentorship
paragraphs: To support vocational school partners, the platform incorporates a dedicated virtual internship infrastructure isolated from the general commercial catalog.

Server-Enforced Attendance Windows: Attendance check-ins are restricted to a mandatory 09:00–12:00 WIB daily window evaluated strictly against UTC+7 server time, rendering client-side clock tampering ineffective. The system automatically locks attendance on weekends and configured national holidays.

High-Touch 1-to-10 Mentorship: Mentors are assigned to dedicated cohorts of maximum 10 interns. This scoped model enables mentors to monitor daily attendance in real time, assign specialized project deliverables, and conduct rigorous evaluations.

Mandatory Structured Feedback: When deliverables require revisions, the system strictly mandates written feedback from the mentor before the task can be returned to the student, fostering a constructive iterative review process.

Cumulative Grading & Audit Trail: Final evaluations are calculated on a 0–100 numerical scale and automatically converted to standard letter grades (A through E/F), with full audit logging for partner institutional compliance.

blocks.heading: Administrative control & learning analytics
paragraphs: The administrative suite equips superadmins with centralized governance tools across learning analytics, curriculum publishing, financial transactions, and user access control.

Learning Analytics Dashboard (LAD): Consolidates 12-month revenue trajectories, enrollment velocity, sales breakdown by category, and course completion metrics into actionable operational visualizations.
Curriculum & Media Engine: Allows comprehensive authoring of course hierarchies (Sprints and Stages), direct video uploads to Bunny.net Stream, and multi-variant quiz bank construction.

Internship Operations & Multi-Role RBAC: Simplifies the orchestration of internship batches, classes, and quota limits while maintaining strict role-based access control (RBAC). Superadmins can invite new administrative personnel via time-bounded 24-hour single-use activation tokens with complete audit traceability.

blocks.heading: Architectural rigor & engineering decisions
paragraphs: NextLevel Academy reflects deliberate software engineering practices designed to balance high performance, cost efficiency, and transactional reliability across a monolithic Next.js 16 deployment.

High-Performance Certificate Generation (Satori + Sharp): Headless browser PDF generation typically consumes 200–400 MB of RAM per process. Replacing Chromium with Satori (JSX to SVG) and native C++ Sharp (SVG to PNG) reduced memory consumption by 90%, enabling instantaneous certificate rendering on a modest 2GB RAM production VPS.

Idempotent Payment Webhooks: The order fulfillment pipeline (fulfillOrderPaid) is structured to resist race conditions from duplicate webhook calls, coupled with automated reconciliation against the Midtrans Get-Status API to guarantee 100% order fulfillment integrity.

Tamper-Resistant Server Guards: By decoupling all temporal logic from the client device and resolving time, weekends, and holidays strictly against UTC+7 server clocks, the platform guarantees attendance compliance for institutional partner auditing.
